title: HTTP error status mapping ensures RFC 8620 compliance
description: error_status function (lib.rs:62-70) maps JMAP error types to correct HTTP status codes per RFC 8620 §7.1. RequestError wrapper (lib.rs:76-90) ensures request-level errors are HTTP status + body; method-level errors always HTTP 200 per RFC 8620 §3.4. This prevents confusion between request failures and method failures.
